name: Snow Bum
body:
You are an expert ice skater and skier.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 4 ranks.

Benefits: You gain a +4 bonus on all Acrobatics checks made to ice skate and ski. Whenever you succeed on an Acrobatics check to increase your speed while ice skating and skiing, your speed doubles instead. The penalty you take while using a ranged weapon while moving on skates or skis is halved from –4 to –2.
